STATE CAPITOL—FOURTH FLOOR—DISMARCK, NORTH DAKOTA 58501 701 224-2818
July 10, 1972
STATE INTERGOVERNMENTAL CLEARINGHOUSE "LETTER OF COMMENT" ON PROJECT REVIEW IN CONFORMANCE WITH OMB CIRCULAR NO. A-95
TO: Secretary of the Interior
Mr. Rogers C. B. Morton, Secretary Department of the Interior Washington, D. C. 20240
Dear Mr. Morton:
Subject: Draft Environmental Impact Statement regarding implementation of Executive Order 11644 which provides for the control of use of off-road vehicles on public lands. This draft document would establish implementation procedures.
This application was received in our office on June 14, 1972.
In the process of the A-95 review, the attached comments were received from the State Highway Department and the State Forest Service.
This document and attachments constitute the comment of the State Intergovernmental Clearinghouse, made in compliance with OMB Circular No. A-95.
Sincerely yours,
Miss Bonnie E. Austin
Burnie & Cluston
Associate Planner
